name: Lemon Squeezy
summary: A Merchant of Record and creator-commerce platform for digital products, software, subscriptions, downloads, and license keys.

pricing.headline: 5% + $0.50 per transaction, with additional fees in documented edge cases and volume pricing by request.
pricing.assumptions: Base ecommerce fee applies to the tax-inclusive order total. International cards, subscriptions, PayPal, payouts, and the usual $15 dispute fee can add costs.

currencySupport.presentment: Products can be displayed in 130 store currencies, but this is localization rather than native processing in each currency.
currencySupport.customerCharge: Every transaction is ultimately charged in USD, even when checkout and the receipt show another store currency.
currencySupport.settlement: The seller's proceeds and payouts are USD; a non-USD bank payout is converted into the selected bank currency at payout time.
currencySupport.buyerFx: Lemon Squeezy says it adds no checkout conversion fee, but the buyer's bank may charge FX because the actual card charge is USD.
currencySupport.merchantFx: Non-US bank payouts cost 1%; a payout processor also converts USD to the selected bank currency. PayPal can add its own conversion or withdrawal fee.
currencySupport.moneyPath: local display → USD customer charge → USD payout → bank currency

marketExamples.path: USD charge → USD payout → USD bank
marketExamples.cost: The displayed, charged, payout, and bank currencies can all remain USD. Standard transaction fees still apply.

marketExamples.path: EUR display → USD charge → USD payout → EUR bank
marketExamples.cost: The buyer's bank may convert the USD card charge; the seller then pays the 1% non-US payout fee plus payout-processor FX to EUR.

marketExamples.path: CHF display → USD charge → USD payout → CHF bank
marketExamples.cost: The buyer's bank may convert the USD card charge; the seller then pays the 1% non-US payout fee plus payout-processor FX to CHF.

sellerCoverage: Payouts are available in more than 200 countries according to Lemon Squeezy, subject to onboarding and payout-method rules.
buyerCoverage: Global digital sales with multi-currency checkout and country-dependent payment methods.
products: SaaS, digital downloads, subscriptions, memberships, courses, and other eligible digital products.

features.checkout: Hosted and overlay checkout plus a hosted storefront.
features.subscriptions: Recurring billing, usage-based and seat options, trials, changes, and dunning.
features.invoicing: Automatic buyer receipts and tax documents; verify complex B2B quote requirements.
features.paymentMethods: Cards, PayPal, wallets, and supported local methods.
features.payouts: Bank wire or PayPal payouts, generally processed twice monthly.

responsibilities.note: Lemon Squeezy states that it is the Merchant of Record.
Included in its ecommerce platform, subject to policy.
The platform can deliver files and keys; the seller owns the product experience.
The seller must account for net payouts and its own taxes.

strengths: Digital delivery and license keys included
Subscriptions and email tools in one product
limitations: Base fee is charged on the tax-inclusive total and does not cover every add-on
Less suitable for complex enterprise billing
Provider ownership and product direction are a dependency
avoidIf: You require full control of the merchant relationship
